title: Nice quality comforter, works in both warm and cooler climates
text: Nice quality comforter, works in both warm and cooler climates. Well made down comforter, perfect for any kind of weather. Although down does tend to be thought of for winter, I find it perfect year round. This is a soft comforter and I use it in my guest room with colorful pillow shams so the white is perfect for any room. I did deduct a star as it didn't seem as big as it should for a queen, I found the width of it to be a tad short on my bed (so I needed to pull it to one side a bit more so you couldn't see the mattress when entering the bedroom). Other than that, it's a nice quality comforter.
